title: Rich Dad Poor Dad
author: Robert T. Kiyosaki
description: A personal finance classic that explores different approaches to money, investing, financial independence, and building wealth.

title: The 48 Laws of Power
author: Robert Greene
description: An insightful exploration of power, influence, strategy, and human behavior through historical examples and practical principles.

title: Treasure Island
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
description: A classic adventure story filled with pirates, hidden treasure, danger, and unforgettable journeys across the sea.

title: The Sun and Her Flowers
author: Rupi Kaur
description: A collection of poetry exploring love, loss, healing, growth, relationships, and finding strength within yourself.

title: The Lean Startup
author: Eric Ries
description: A practical guide to building businesses through experimentation, continuous learning, customer feedback, and efficient innovation.

title: The Anxious Investor
author: Scott Nations
description: A practical look at investing psychology, uncertainty, risk, and strategies for making more confident financial decisions.

title: The Psychology of Money
author: Morgan Housel
description: A collection of stories and lessons about how emotions, behavior, and personal experiences influence the way people manage money.

title: Leaves of Grass
author: Walt Whitman
description: A landmark collection of poetry celebrating nature, individuality, humanity, freedom, and the beauty of everyday life.

title: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
description: A practical guide to building good habits, breaking bad ones, and making small changes that lead to remarkable results.

title: The Call of the Wild
author: Jack London
description: An adventurous tale of survival and transformation following a dog as he discovers his instincts in the harsh wilderness.

title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
author: J.K. Rowling
description: Harry Potter discovers a magical world and begins his first year at Hogwarts, where friendship, mystery, and adventure await him.

title: Frankenstein
author: Mary Shelley
description: A timeless gothic novel about ambition, scientific discovery, responsibility, and the tragic consequences of creating life.

title: Pet Sematary
author: Stephen King
description: A chilling horror story about grief, loss, and the terrifying consequences of discovering a place where the dead can return.

title: King Solomon's Mines
author: H. Rider Haggard
description: A classic adventure featuring a dangerous expedition into unexplored territory in search of legendary treasure and a lost kingdom.

title: The Alchemist

description: The inspiring journey of Santiago, a young shepherd who follows his dreams in search of treasure and discovers his true purpose.

title: The Hobbit
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: Bilbo Baggins leaves his quiet life behind and joins an extraordinary adventure involving dwarves, dragons, treasure, and a dangerous journey.

title: The Collected Poems
author: Sylvia Plath
description: A powerful collection of poetry exploring identity, relationships, emotions, nature, and the complexities of the human experience.

title: Dracula
author: Bram Stoker
description: A legendary gothic horror novel following Count Dracula and the terrifying events surrounding his attempt to spread his influence.

title: Journey to the Center of the Earth
author: Jules Verne
description: An exciting scientific adventure in which explorers journey deep beneath the Earth's surface and encounter extraordinary hidden worlds.

title: The Waste Land
author: T. S. Eliot
description: A landmark modernist poem exploring fragmentation, cultural change, memory, spirituality, and the uncertainty of the modern world.
